states.name: Formation Lane — US LLC state map for agents
states.description: Machine-readable map of US LLC formation fees, annual or biennial report fees, due-date rules and late penalties for all 50 states plus DC, with Formation Lane guide URLs and official state source links. Free to use. Not a filing service or paid API. Fees change; confirm on the official state page before filing or quoting a number.
states.license_note: Free to reuse and cite with a link to guide_url or the dataset page; no warranty.
states.citation: Formation Lane, “LLC Fees and Deadlines by State (2026–2027),” https://formationlane.com/data/ (last verified 30 October 2026).

dataset.name: LLC Fees and Deadlines by State (2026–2027)

states.fields_note: formation_fee_usd_best_effort is the first dollar amount in formation_filing_fee, or the stated minimum for per-member fees (null when blank); read formation_filing_fee for add-ons and alternatives. Blank facts are null, never guessed.

states.title: Form an LLC in Alabama
states.franchise_or_privilege_tax: Business Privilege Tax — separate ADOR return (often due April 15)
states.note: Alabama Business Privilege Tax is a separate Department of Revenue filing (often due April 15; minimum tax often $0 after 2024 changes, but a return may still be required).

states.title: Form an LLC in Alaska
states.due_date_or_rule: January 2, every 2 years (same odd/even year as formation)
states.note: Formed in an even year → reports in even years; odd → odd years. Filing opens October 2; late fee applies on or after February 2.

states.title: Form an LLC in Arizona
states.note: Keep your statutory agent current with the Arizona Corporation Commission.

states.title: Form an LLC in Arkansas
states.franchise_or_privilege_tax: Annual Franchise Tax Report $150 (the report itself)
states.note: Confirm the current fee on the official state site before filing or paying anyone to file.

states.title: Form an LLC in California
states.due_date_or_rule: Every 2 years, by last day of anniversary month
states.franchise_or_privilege_tax: $800 annual LLC tax (FTB Form 3522), due April 15; LLC fee if CA gross receipts $250,000+
states.note: Confirm the current fee on the official state site before filing or paying anyone to file.

states.title: Form an LLC in Colorado

states.note: Colorado lets you file up to two months before or after the report month without penalty — check your entity summary.

states.title: Form an LLC in Tennessee
states.franchise_or_privilege_tax: Franchise & excise tax returns for most LLCs (due April 15)

states.title: Form an LLC in Texas
states.recurring_report: No SOS annual report — Franchise Tax / Public Information Report
states.franchise_or_privilege_tax: Franchise tax: $0 if revenue ≤ $2.65M; report + PIR still due May 15
states.note: Comptroller franchise tax report + Public Information Report each May 15. No tax due at or below the $2.65M threshold, but you still file.

states.due_date_or_rule: Every year, by last day of anniversary month
states.note: Due by the last day of the anniversary month; can be filed up to 60 days early (Utah Code 16-1a-212, effective October 1, 2026).
